title: Deploy the development environment into chatticus-development
description:
First real environment in a new account, as the proving ground (per 2e4d79). ThinTurn, Web and Auth development plus the per-account shared stacks the app needs (Snapshots, Computers, Budgets). Start empty: new DynamoDB, new Cognito user pool, new queues; no data copied yet. Legacy development is not touched and keeps serving dev.chattic.us until cutover.

Needs: the bootstrap and deploy-role card, and the DNS decision. Also decide the account id the customer role template trusts (AnthusAccountId) for this environment, and set CHATTICUS_INSTALLATION_NAME and the budgets values for the account. Verify by a real sign-in and message on the new environment's own hostname before anything is repointed.
